class.name: Dialogues
class.brief_description: [Dialogue] resources collection resource used in the UT-style dialogue system.
class.description:
The Dialogues resource serves to bundle and manage multiple [Dialogue] resources together. Used to create dialogue sequences in the UT-style dialogue system.
[b]Example (GDScript)[/b] [codeblock] var dialogues = Dialogues.new() .from(["Hello!", "Nice to meet you", "How are you?"]) .set_expressions([0, 1, 2]) .set_speed([0.08, 0.06, 0.10]) [/codeblock]
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: from
method.description: Creates [Dialogue] resources from a string array and adds them to this [Dialogues] resource. Each string is set as an individual [member Dialogue.dialog_text] value. The return value is this [Dialogues] resource itself. Can be used for method chaining.

method.name: get_dialogues_single
method.description: Extracts only specific type of data from all [Dialogue]s and returns it as an array. Please refer to the [constant DialogueType] enum below for available data types.

method.name: set_expressions
method.description: Sets [member Dialogue.dialog_expressions] values for all dialogues. [Dialogue] resources must already exist for this to work. The return value is this [Dialogues] resource itself. Can be used for method chaining.

method.name: set_speed
method.description: Sets [member Dialogue.dialog_speed] values for all dialogues. [Dialogue] resources must already exist for this to work. The return value is this [Dialogues] resource itself. Can be used for method chaining.

method.name: set_pauses
method.description:
Sets [member Dialogue.pauses] values for all [Dialogue]s. [Dialogue] resources must already exist for this to work. The return value is this [Dialogues] resource itself. Can be used for method chaining.
[b]Usage examples:[/b] [codeblock] # Setting single pause for each dialogue dialogues.set_pauses([ {"index": 3, "duration": 0.5}, # First dialogue: pause for 0.5 seconds after 3rd character {"index": 2, "duration": 1.0}, # Second dialogue: pause for 1.0 seconds after 2nd character {} # Third dialogue: no pause ])
# Setting multiple pauses for each dialogue dialogues.set_pauses([ [ {"index": 2, "duration": 0.3}, {"index": 5, "duration": 0.7} ], # First dialogue [ {"index": 4, "duration": 1.0} ], # Second dialogue [] # Third dialogue: no pause ]) [/codeblock]

members.member: Array of managed Dialogue objects. Each element must be a Dialogue resource. You can compose dialogue sequences through this member.

constants.constant:
Type representing the text content of dialogue.
Used with the [method get_dialogues_single] method to extract all dialogue dialog_text values as a string array.
[b]Return type:[/b] PackedStringArray or Array[String]

Type representing the entire expression sequence of dialogue.
Used with the [method get_dialogues_single] method to extract the entire dialog_expressions array of each dialogue in nested array format.
[b]Return type:[/b] Array[Array] (array of expression arrays for each dialogue)

Type representing the pause arrays of dialogues that have pause settings.
Used with the [method get_dialogues_single] method to extract only the pause settings of dialogues whose pauses array is not empty.
[b]Return type:[/b] Array[Array] (pauses arrays of dialogues that have pauses)
[b]Note:[/b] Dialogues without pauses are not included in the result.

Type representing the typing speed of dialogue.
Used with the [method get_dialogues_single] method to extract all dialogue dialog_speed values as a float array.
[b]Return type:[/b] Array[float] (typing speeds of each dialogue)
